# Blue strip is at row 41, symbols at cols 15,22,29,36,43
# Current cursor is on pink strip (row ~52-55)
# Let me check if I can move cursor to blue strip and cycle those symbols

# First, check cursor position
seg = current_frame.segmentation
cursor_pos = None
for node in seg['nodes']:
    if node['color'] == 'W':
        b = node['boundary']
        min_row = min(p[0] for p in b)
        min_col = min(p[1] for p in b)
        cursor_pos = (min_row, min_col)
        break

print(f"Cursor: {cursor_pos}")

# Try moving UP to reach blue strip
# Blue strip is at row 41, cursor is likely at row 53-55
# Try going UP several times
action(['UP', 'UP', 'UP', 'UP', 'UP', 'UP'])

seg = current_frame.segmentation
cursor_pos = None
for node in seg['nodes']:
    if node['color'] == 'W':
        b = node['boundary']
        min_row = min(p[0] for p in b)
        min_col = min(p[1] for p in b)
        cursor_pos = (min_row, min_col)
        break

print(f"Cursor after UPs: {cursor_pos}")

# Check what changed in pink/blue strips
blue_syms = []
pink_syms = []
for node in seg['nodes']:
    if node['color'] == 'B':
        b = node['boundary']
        min_row = min(p[0] for p in b)
        min_col = min(p[1] for p in b)
        if 40 <= min_row <= 43:
            blue_syms.append({'col': min_col, 'hash': node['hash'][:8]})
        if 50 <= min_row <= 55:
            pink_syms.append({'col': min_col, 'hash': node['hash'][:8]})

blue_syms.sort(key=lambda x: x['col'])
pink_syms.sort(key=lambda x: x['col'])
print(f"Blue: {[s['hash'] for s in blue_syms]}")
print(f"Pink: {[s['hash'] for s in pink_syms]}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
